snippet.title: Blanky // Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870300/Blanky/

Blanky tells the story of a young boy named Jacob, who is thrown into a nightmarish world, filled with his biggest fears. With the help of his Blanket, nicknamed "Blanky" Jacob unlocks new abilities in search of the courage needed to defeat the evils within his own mind.

Developed by 
Winter Cabin
